title: Declared test commands: validate NUnit, MSTest and Microsoft Testing Platform (MTP) result shapes beyond the xUnit/VSTest TRX pilot
outcome: A declared .NET test command using NUnit, MSTest, or the Microsoft Testing Platform is judged PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN correctly from its result artifact, each shape proven with real captures, or explicitly documented as unsupported.
acceptance: For each of NUnit (via VSTest TRX), MSTest (via VSTest TRX) and MTP (its TRX extension or native report), a real sanitized capture of a passing, a failing and a zero-test run is added as a fixture and the TRX reader classifies each correctly, or the docs state the shape as unsupported with the reason.
Host-observed pass and fail runs in a disposable .tmp scratch repository for each supported shape credit or publish as the docs state.
